profile.tagline: I build systems that see, understand, and decide in real time.
profile.bio: Self-taught full-stack developer. I split my time between writing code and prototyping — my playground is computer vision, real-time interfaces, and anything that turns a raw data stream into something useful. OmniSight grew out of that obsession.

inventions.name: OmniSight
inventions.tagline: One layer of perception for any video feed.
inventions.description: OmniSight merges multiple video sources into a single coherent scene: detection, tracking, and re-identification across cameras, with latency held under 40ms. The goal isn't more screens — it's one readable version of reality, legible to a human and a machine alike.

inventions.name: Pulse Grid
inventions.description: A visualization engine that absorbs thousands of events per second without choking the browser. Canvas rendering, client-side aggregation, history compressed in memory.

inventions.name: Atlas CLI
inventions.description: A command-line tool that scaffolds an entire project — API, database, front-end, CI — from a simple schema described in YAML.
